about: The prayer professes that through Christ God continually creates all these good things, sanctifies them, gives them life, blesses them, and bestows them upon us. The relative “quem” refers to Christ, named at the end of the preceding prayer.

s01.translation: Through whom You continue to make all these good things, O Lord;

s02.narrative: The priest makes three signs of the cross over the Host and chalice together.

s03.translation: You sanctify them, fill them with life, bless them, and bestow them upon us.

w002.function: Quem refers to Christ, named at the end of the preceding prayer.

w007.function: Predicative complement with creas: You create them good.
